Added an installable native GitLab CI provider for custom workers, Mass Compile, VI Analyzer, Unit Tests, Antidoc, SBOM Generation, Builds, VIDiff, and both snapshot paths. It publishes private project-registry workers, preserves Pages report history, and keeps existing root GitLab pipelines safe during installation. GitLab-hosted Linux Docker-in-Docker worker builds are verified; Windows jobs still need a self-managed Docker-capable runner. Linux VIPM bakes now show install phases and fail closed with focused diagnostics when a package action fails, so incomplete workers are never published. A package-owned post-install VI must itself support unattended Linux execution; VIPM cannot safely skip it.
